newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota forms China car parts unit.
newsitem.headline: Toyota forms China car parts unit.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Friday it had formed a wholly owned subsidiary in Tianjin, China, to produce components.
Tianjin Toyota Forging Co Ltd, capitalised at about 3.7 billion yen, would start producing universal joint parts in December 1998, a Toyota spokesman said.

The parts would be supplied to another Toyota car-part unit, Tianjin Fengjing Auto Parts Co Ltd, to produce universal joints. Tianjin Fengjing has a production capacity of 150,000 universal joints per year.
The universal joints will be used in Daihatsu-designed 1,300cc Charade cars made by Tianjin Automobile Industrial Corp in Tianjin.
Tianjin Automobile produced 96,000 1,000cc Charades in 1996, up 46 percent from a year earlier.
Tianjin Toyota Forging will produce 400,000 units annually sometime in the future, of which half will be exported, the spokesman said.
The new company is Toyota's third car-part firm in China. The other is Tianjin Toyota Motor Engine Co Ltd which is expected to start producing 1.3-litre gasoline engines in early 1998.
